summary: The bearer's other Enchantments cannot be removed by Dispel Magic or similar abilities; Sleight of Mind does not count towards the Enchantment limit.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Covers Enchantments worn by the bearer other than Sleight of Mind itself; against Dispel Magic or similar abilities.

properties.note: Does not count towards the bearer's Enchantment Limit.

clarifications.text: Sleight of Mind itself is not protected: Dispel Magic or similar abilities can still remove it.

open_questions: 'Similar abilities' is undefined; presumably other Enchantment-removing abilities (e.g. Naturalize Magic's Dispel Magic), but the text does not list them.
